name: RC-B10-0173/2024 – § 6 – Am 21
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text: 6. Expresses concerns about the lack of proportionality and the potential economic impact of the imposition of outdoor bans, in particular those on restaurants, cafés and bars, especially in tourist regions where outdoor terraces are widely used and contribute to a substantial part of the income of the operators in this sector; highlights the fact that such bans negatively affect citizens’ freedom;
